text:
anya: FYI I brought up mosaic-micro v1.2 (q4/int8) on staging last night. Quick smoke looks fine but full eval shows regressing BLEU on zh->en and bracket orientation flips on ar/he.

sam: can you paste the eval command and the specific metrics? :eyes:

anya: sure. Ran the standard suite:
```
./eval_pipeline --model mosaic-micro:v1.2-int8 --tasks zh->en,ja->en,ar->en,he->en --metrics bleu,exact_match,bracket_flip --out out/173800
```
Top-line:
- zh->en BLEU: 28.3 (baseline 31.1)
- ja->en BLEU: 30.2 (baseline 30.5)
- ar->en bracket_flip rate: 0.9% (baseline 0.1%)
- he->en bracket_flip rate: 1.2% (baseline 0.2%)

lee: that's a sizable delta for zh->en. Did you compare tokenization diffs? Could be subtoken merging.

anya: I dumped token boundaries for a failing sample. Example (baseline vs int8):
```
baseline tokens: [我][爱][你][。]
int8 tokens:     [我爱][你][。]
```
This creates different alignment and hurts BLEU on some samples.

rui: interesting. Did quantization change the tokenizer or vocab mapping? It shouldn't but sometimes our ONNX export pipeline reorders token IDs when pruning.

anya: I checked the vocab hash; mapping matches. But the model output token IDs early in sequence differ — suggests small logit shifts change greedy decoding path.

marcus: could be numeric stability in softmax for mixed precision kernels. Which runtime used on staging (A100 TF32 vs T4 FP16 fallback)?

anya: Dedicated staging pool used T4 + Triton fallback. In Hosted we test on A100, but this bring-up was on dedicated int8 nodes.

eva: I can reproduce bracket_flip on a short ar sample. Here's minimal repro input and outputs:
Input: "عناصر (a, b) تم ترتيبها"
Baseline decode: "elements (a, b) were ordered"
Int8 decode:     "elements )a, b( were ordered"  :grimacing:

sam: lol bracket mirror. That points at bidi/RTL detokenization step maybe being sensitive to token-level boundaries.

lee: action plan suggestion:
1) run evaluation with sampling/beam 5 to see if beam search masks noisy greedy divergences
2) run quantized forward with FP32 logits capture (shadow run) to compare logits and top-k
3) add tokenization diffs histogram across dev set

anya: started 1 & 3. For 2 I need help attaching FP32 shadow run to Triton container — infra-bot do we have an easy toggle?

infra-bot: @anya You can enable shadow_fp32 in the model config via:
```
redwood deploy update --model mosaic-micro:v1.2-int8 --set shadow_fp32=true
```
Will run FP32 echo alongside int8 for comparison (costly).

rui: nice. Also try swapping to the baseline kernel set (fallback kernels) to confirm kernel selection impact. Use env KERNEL_PROFILE=baseline.

anya: running the shadow_fp32 + kernel_profile swap now. ETA ~25m. Posting logs to thread when done.

(25m passes)

anya: results in: shadow_fp32 logits top-1 match with baseline 99.3% for ja/zh but only 96.1% for zh on first 20 tokens. Token boundary diffs concentrated in CJK ideograph sequences and punctuation.

lee: 96% mismatch explains BLEU swing. For CJK sequences we should prefer no prefix-merging during quantized sampling — maybe our KV cache truncation threshold differs.

marcus: could also be temperature/batch normalization differences due to changed softmax scale in int8 path. Can we run KDE of logit magnitudes per layer pre-softmax for zh vs en samples? If int8 compresses tail logits they drop below rounding and tie-break differently.

anya: I captured per-layer pre-softmax l2 norms for a failing batch. Summary: layer 4-6 L2 drops ~8-12% vs shadow_fp32 for CJK inputs only.

eva: ok that's actionable. Next steps:
- triage with quant team: check kernel math scaling and accumulators for layers 4-6 on T4 int8 path
- re-run int8 with alternative rounding mode (stochastic vs nearest) if supported
- add locale-specific smoke gate: if zh BLEU delta > 1.0 then fail canary

sam: agree. Also tag this run so we can roll back quickly if we promote mosaic-micro to prod. Add a canary flag in rollout config.

rui: I'll open a bisect ticket with per-kernel tests. Marcus, can infra repro with A100 int8 path to see if hardware-specific? If problem disappears on A100 we'll route zh->a100 until fixed.

marcus: will run A100 repro.

anya: created issues/3187 with logs + sample repros and attached the failing tweet-length sample set. Marking P2 for now.

lee: thanks. One more ask: add a small detokenization guard for RTL bracket pairs to mitigation patch (server-side) so we can hotfix if needed.

eva: I'll draft a tiny detok patch that enforces mirror order for bracket pairs if token adjacency matches knownRTL sequence. Will run as middleware.

anya: thanks everyone. I'll update thread with A100 results and quant-team response. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deployment snapshot saved: deploy-173800-anya-mosaic-int8-checkpoint
